items.name: Westend Mega NxNxN Berlin 2026
items.information:
**Deutsch**

**Berlin ist Mega!** Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur Westend Mega NxNxN Competition in Berlin, im schönen Bezirk Charlottenburg, Ortsteil Westend. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue direkt an der Stadtautobahn mitten in Berlin, tolle Disziplinen und vor allem großzügige Cutoffs, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr.

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Zeitplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**

**English**

**Berlin is Mega!** We warmly invite you to the Westend Mega NxNxN Competition in Berlin, in the beautiful Westend part of the district Charlottenburg. We, the organizing team, look forward to seeing you there. You can expect a beautiful venue right next to the city highway in the heart of Berlin, great disciplines, and, above all, generous cutoffs, a motivated organizing team, and much more. 

**Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

items.information:

items.name: CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2026
items.information:
This competition is recognized by **[CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/)** as the Southeast [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2026. Residents of **Alabama**, **Florida**, **Georgia**, **North Carolina**, **South Carolina**, and **Tennessee** are eligible for the title of Southeast Champion - please see the [Southeast Residency tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2026#62156-southeast-residency) for more information.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQzMTc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cb3247b4723a89667b181660cbc20065f92b7a90/SEC%2026%20logo.png)

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2026#62162-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.

items.name: Abilene Spring 2026
items.information:
Welcome to the first ever WCA competition in Abilene! Please be sure to read over all the tabs for more information regarding the competition. 

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
